questions.question: Highway signs that show hazardous conditions are called:
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to dangerous conditions ahead. Follow these signs for your safety. Ignoring a warning sign can cause accidents.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb:

options.text: Keep the front wheel straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn your wheels away from the curb. If your brakes fail, your car will roll toward the curb, not into traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you a traffic signal is coming. Get ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, you must allow for:

options.text: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
The decreased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
The decreased noise of larger vehicles.
The increased speed of larger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles. Stay where the truck driver can see you. Do not block the truck driver's view of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: Which light means you should slow down and be careful at an intersection?
questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing yellow light
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be ready to stop. Watch for other traffic.

questions.question: When driving on ice or snow, what helps prevent crashes?

options.text: Add extra weight to their vehicles to improve traction.
Get off the highways as quickly as possible.
Engage the four-wheel drive on their vehicles.
Reduce their speed and increase their following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce their speed and increase their following distance.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snowy or icy roads. Increase the distance between your car and the car in front of you. These are the best ways to avoid crashes.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you:

options.text: Must drive slowly to allow approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to get out of your way.
Must honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to give you room.
Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
Can disregard any pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the road from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians. Stop before crossing the sidewalk. Failure to stop is against the law.

questions.question: Your vehicle takes longer to stop on:

options.text: On a wet or icy road.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a wet or icy road.
questions.explanation: Wet or icy roads increase stopping distance. Loose gravel or stones also increase stopping distance.

questions.question: If you are in an accident and someone is injured, you should:

options.text: Moved the injured away from the scene immediately.
Always leave the injured where they are.
Not move the injured unnecessarily. Keep the injured warm and administer first aid.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not move the injured unnecessarily. Keep the injured warm and administer first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move injured people unless necessary. Moving them incorrectly can make minor injuries worse. Keep them warm until help arrives. If there is heavy bleeding, apply direct pressure to stop it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is broken.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic light is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: One-way traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic flows in only one direction on this street. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: Drive below the posted speed limit when:

options.text: You are entering a highway with other cars.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Conditions are not perfect.
questions.explanation: Slow down when the road is wet or slippery, when visibility is poor, or when anything else is not ideal. You can be ticketed for speeding even if you are under the speed limit if conditions require slower driving.

questions.question: A yellow light that flashes on and off means:

options.text: Stop, look both ways, then go if the road is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and proceed carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: You may carefully continue through an intersection when a yellow light appears if:

options.text: An emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the yellow light appears, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: Downward-pointing triangle signs mean:
questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle sign means you must yield. Slow down and let other traffic pass. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: Which does not affect how far your vehicle travels before stopping?

options.text: Time before you notice the danger

questions.correctAnswerText: Steering ability
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, how far you travel while reacting, and how far you travel while braking. Steering ability does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: Stopping distance does not depend on:

options.text: What time of day it is.

questions.correctAnswerText: What time of day it is.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, road conditions, your vehicle's weight, brake condition, tire condition, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle, you should:

options.text: Move to the right side of the road as safely as possible and stop.
Drive slowly and let the vehicle pass.
Stay on the right side and keep moving slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side of the road as safely as possible and stop.
questions.explanation: Move to the right side of the road as far as safely possible and stop. Do not stop in an intersection. Let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass, even if it is dangerous.
You may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. Dashed white lines can be crossed to pass or change lanes when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before you pass, check that the passing lane is clear. Use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: A transit bus signals that it is returning to the main road after a stop. What must you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to let them know you are there.
Speed up to pass the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to the bus.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus that is signaling to return to the main road after stopping. Change lanes, slow down, or stop to let the bus merge safely.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs indicate?
questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zones.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text that says it is a no passing zone.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing with no flashing lights or gates. What should you do?

options.text: Cross the tracks immediately and as quickly as possible.
Always stop before crossing the tracks.
Be ready to yield to any train.
Speed up to beat any oncoming train.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield to any train.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to yield to trains at railroad crossings, especially when there are no lights or gates. Do not cross until your entire vehicle can fit on the other side. Do not change gears while crossing the tracks.

questions.question: Your vehicle begins to skid. What should you do?

options.text: Turn the wheel too far in the opposite direction.
Turn your steering wheel into traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction the vehicle is skidding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction the vehicle is skidding.
questions.explanation: Stay calm if your vehicle skids. Steer in the direction the vehicle is sliding.

questions.question: You may not park within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
questions.correctAnswerText: 15 feet
questions.explanation: Do not park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. Park only in legal spaces where other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means "caution." Slow down, look both ways, and proceed with care.

questions.question: When approaching an accident scene, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Stop only if you are involved or emergency help has not arrived.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not stop at an accident unless you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Stay focused on driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not stop just to look.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side where traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road that faces oncoming traffic in the nearest lane.

questions.question: Your vehicle does not have Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS) and you need to stop quickly. What should you do?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pump your brakes firmly.
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop quickly in an emergency. This allows you to stop fast and still steer your vehicle.
